about.title: Hi, I'm Islombek
about.intro: An 18-year-old developer and graphic designer from Namangan. MONTRAX is my brand: no team, just me — and that's the strength: design and code from one pair of hands.
about.story1: Most people either draw or build. I do both — and that combination saves my clients time and money: there's no "translation" step between designer and developer, the idea goes straight into a working product.
about.story2: In 2026 I shipped four systems to production: Mix Mobile CRM for a phone store, Montrax Savdo for sales management, and the KinoDam movie-search bot. In parallel I design thumbnails, posters and product cards for YouTube channels and shops.
about.process1desc: I start with the problem, not the tech. A beautiful answer to the wrong question is useless.
about.process2desc: Quick sketches on paper or Figma, then a working prototype. The client sees progress at every step.
about.process3desc: Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma — production-grade code. Deploy, handover, support.

servicesPage.title: Services & starting prices
servicesPage.sub: These are starting prices. The exact number depends on scope — after a 10-minute chat on Telegram I'll give you a concrete quote.
servicesPage.priceNote: Listed prices are minimum starting values. The final quote depends on scope, timeline and complexity. Larger projects can be split into milestone payments.
servicesPage.faq1a: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. Larger projects can be split into milestones — we'll agree on it.
servicesPage.faq2a: I set realistic deadlines upfront and flag any change early. No silent delays.
servicesPage.faq3q: Do you make changes after delivery?
servicesPage.faq3a: Yes. Two weeks of small fixes are free after handover; after that we work hourly or on a monthly support plan.
servicesPage.faq4q: Can I order just design, or just code?
servicesPage.faq4a: Absolutely. Many clients come for a thumbnail alone or a bot alone — the combo is optional.
